facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The existence of the temple is traced at least to 1422–1461.
facts.text: Epigraphical and historical records show that the construction of the Vittala temple began in the 15th century during the reign of King Deva Raya II.

facts.label: legend
facts.quote: Each main pillar is wrapped with seven minor pillars that each 'play' one of the seven notes in the Indian classical music scale.
facts.text: Popular folklore claims that each cluster features minor colonnettes tuned to reproduce the seven notes of the Indian classical scale known as Sa-Re-Ga-Ma.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The capital was conquered, pillaged and destroyed by sultanate armies in 1565, after which Hampi remained in ruins.
facts.text: Archaeological records document that fractured columns in the temple hall resulted from the 1565 sack of Vijayanagara and structural weathering rather than an official British cutting investigation.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: Due to concerns over the weakening of the pillars, the ASI restricted access to them.
facts.text: The Archaeological Survey of India prohibited the public from tapping the musical pillars in 2008 to protect the centuries-old granite from structural micro-damage.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: What I saw from thence seemed to me as large as Rome, and very beautiful to the sight; there are many groves of trees within it... This is the best provided city in the world.
facts.source_name: Domingo Paes, Chronica dos reis de Bisnaga (Robert Sewell, A Forgotten Empire)
facts.text: Portuguese merchant Domingo Paes recorded in his chronicle that Vijayanagara appeared as large as Rome and was the best-provisioned city in the world.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: The people in this city are countless in number, so much so that I do not wish to write it down for fear it should be thought fabulous.
facts.source_name: Domingo Paes, Chronica dos reis de Bisnaga (Robert Sewell, A Forgotten Empire)
facts.text: Domingo Paes wrote that the human population of Vijayanagara was so vast that he refrained from writing a specific number for fear of being accused of exaggeration.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: In India in 1500, Vijayanagar had 500,000 inhabitants... second largest city in the world after Beijing.
facts.source_name: Tertius Chandler, Four Thousand Years of Urban Growth
facts.text: Urban historian Tertius Chandler estimated Vijayanagara's population around 1500 CE at 500,000, ranking it as the world's second-largest city behind Beijing.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: Estimates of the population of the urban core and greater metropolitan region of Vijayanagara vary widely across historical and archaeological literature, ranging between 250,000 and 500,000 residents.
facts.source_name: Scientific Data / Historical Urban Population Data: Vijayanagara
facts.text: Landscape archaeologists dispute the uniform 500,000 figure, noting that estimates for Vijayanagara's peak population vary between 250,000 and 500,000 depending on how much of the surrounding agrarian hinterland is included.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Illustrated panel, early 16th century: a Portuguese merchant in a wide hat stands on a rocky hill at golden hour, looking down at a vast walled city of granite temples, groves and bazaars, writing in a leather journal, mood of awe

scenes.vo: Kya patthar ke khambe sur gaa sakte hain? Portuguese vyapari Domingo Paes ne Vijayanagara ko Rome jitna bada likha.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Illustrated panel: a grandmother sits with children in the carved granite hall of the Vittala temple at dusk, pointing to slender clustered stone pillars, faint glowing sound waves drawn in the air, warm magical mood

scenes.vo: Isi sheher Hampi mein Vittala mandir hai. Lok kahani kehti hai, iske khambe sa re ga ma bajate hain.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Illustrated panel: an archaeologist in a khaki shirt studies an old stone inscription beside the temple wall, a notebook and brush in hand, carvings of the Vittala temple behind, calm investigative mood

scenes.vo: ASI yaani desh ki puratattva sanstha. Uske records kehte hain, mandir Raja Deva Raya ke zamane mein bana.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Illustrated panel in hazy dreamlike style: colonial-era officers in pith helmets gather around a cracked stone pillar with lanterns, peering inside, shown as a rumour with soft blurred edges, mysterious mood

scenes.vo: Phir ek kahani chali, Angrezon ne khambe kaate, andar dhaatu dhoondhne. Iska koi pakka sabut nahi milta.

scenes.vo: ASI ke mutabik, 1565 mein sultanate ki fauj ne rajdhani loot li. Toote khambe usi loot aur mausam ki maar hain.

scenes.label: archaeology

scenes.vo: Sheher ke size par bhi bahas hai. Historian Tertius Chandler ise Beijing ke baad sabse bada maante the. Landscape archaeologists kehte hain, anumaan bahut alag-alag hain.
